Title: 资金不再充足？马斯克的xAI拟融资120亿美元

Summary: 
Elon Musk's AI company xAI is planning to raise up to $12 billion in new funding, according to a report by Caixin. The company has received significant funding in the past, including a $60 billion funding round in April and December 2024, and a $100 billion funding round in January 2025. Title: xAIの最新モデル「Grok 4」が全ユーザーに無料開放

Summary: 
xAI has released its latest AI model, Grok 4, to all users for free. The model, which was announced in July, has been described by Elon Musk as 'the world's most intelligent AI'. Title: Elon Musk's xAI is Creating AI-Generated Video Game Built on Nvidia's World Model Tech

Summary: 
xAI, the artificial intelligence company led by Elon Musk, is developing an AI-generated video game powered by world model technology, according to a Financial Times report cited by Analytics Insight. The company has recruited former Nvidia researchers to accelerate the development of next-generation AI systems capable of understanding and interacting with real-world physics. Unlike current large language models trained primarily on text and images, world models focus on interpreting movement, cause and effect, and object behavior in three-dimensional environments, enabling AI to exhibit physical reasoning. This capability will allow the AI to generate adaptive, realistic 3D game environments. Early applications are expected in gaming, with potential future use in robotics and real-world spatial design. The project is being developed with the support of Nvidia's world model technology, and the game is intended to simulate lifelike interactions within digital spaces. Published on October 12, 2025, at 20:00.

Published date: October 12 2025, 20:00

Title: Elon Musk's xAI joins open-source AI race against China

Summary: 
Elon Musk’s AI start‑up xAI has open‑sourced its Grok 2.5 model, an earlier version of its series, and announced that Grok 3 will be released as open source within six months. Musk posted on X.com that Grok 2.5, which the company called its 'best model last year', was uploaded to Hugging Face, the world’s largest open‑source AI platform. The move is part of a broader push by U.S. firms, such as DeepSeek, to offer free AI tools, prompting American labs to rethink their strategies and consider making some products freely available.

Published date: August 25 2025, 09:00
